title: Retire ArrayMesh: measure HalfEdgeMesh on the largest models, then build HalfEdgeMesh everywhere and compile straight to the render buffer
description:
Repo plan merge 3C.15, user's request: 'check if array mesh really needs to exist anymore mostly use halfedge everywhere and seems to be fast enough'. ArrayMesh is referenced by 63 main and 28 test files; every loader (glTF, OBJ, OFF, PLY) builds one, as do about 12 nodes (CubeMesh, Subdivision, Extrude, InsetFaces, Transform, CoonsPatch, CheckerMaterial, GridMapQuads, QuadExtract), GridToMesh2D/3D, DebugCapsuleRuntime, MeshRepair, MeshMergeByDistance and SemanticPatchDecomposer.toArrayMesh (which HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.java:257 calls to upload a mesh). ArrayMeshEngine duplicates HalfEdgeMeshEngine/ops (delete, merge-by-distance, join, subdivide, solidify) and callers branch on instanceof in about 52 places. Step 1: measure HalfEdgeMesh construction time and memory, and render upload, on the largest models (crawfish GLB, fertility, Buddha) against ArrayMesh; record on the ticket. Step 2, if acceptable: producers build HalfEdgeMesh, the renderer compiles straight to HalfEdgeCompiledMeshData, and ArrayMesh, ArrayMeshEngine, QuadMeshTopologyHelper and the instanceof branches are deleted. If the numbers say a dense path must stay for a specific case, stop and report before step 2.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.

User decisions 2026-10-18, after step 1: (a) ArrayMesh stays, under its name, only as the indexed form of meshes HalfEdgeMesh cannot hold (raw non-manifold/degenerate scans, unoriented MeshRepair output); only the loaders and MeshRepair produce it; everything else builds HalfEdgeMesh and ArrayMeshEngine, the converters and the instanceof branches go. The 2.2-2.4x memory of HalfEdgeMesh is accepted. Also move HalfEdgeMeshEngine.compileSurfaceData (the one rendering method in the geometry engine) into the render side, HalfEdgeMeshRuntime, as part of compiling straight to the render buffer.
definition-of-done:
1. Measurements (load, build, upload, memory) for the three models recorded on the ticket before any deletion.
2. If retired: no ArrayMesh, ArrayMeshEngine or QuadMeshTopologyHelper; no instanceof ArrayMesh/HalfEdgeMesh branches; load and first-frame times within the measured budget.
3. Every DSL output and loaded model fingerprint identical to master (MeshCanonicalFingerprint), quad-suite fingerprints unchanged.
4. Unit suite passes; launch entry and screenshots of the crawfish and a subdivided primitive.

7. HalfEdgeMeshEngine.compileSurfaceData lives in the render runtime (HalfEdgeMeshRuntime); the geometry engine has no rendering code.
8. The HalfEdgeBuildBenchmark representationsOnLargestModels report lines ([representation] ...) are the benchmark's output and stay.

9. (User, 2026-10-18) Callers use HalfEdgeMesh directly: no code packs a HalfEdgeMesh into dense arrays to run an old ArrayMesh-era algorithm and rebuild. The modifier nodes (Solidify, LoopCut, Subdivide/Subdivision, Extrude, Inset, Transform), the mesh ops (MeshAppend, MeshDeleteVertices, MeshMergeByDistance, MeshVertexOffset), the analyses (curvature, segmentation, skeleton, MeshDistance, SurfaceCreases), the rings (RingCandidateExtractor, BranchCrossSectionRing) and SkeletonSensitivityAnalyzer, Compare, PatchDecomposerCLI read the mesh in place (active ids, id-indexed arrays sized by the id bound, edits through the HalfEdgeMesh operators). HalfEdgeMeshEngine.compact, denseTriangles, subdivideQuadsOnce and MeshTopology.packedPositions/packedFaceVertices are deleted. No whole-mesh 'every face must be a quad' scan remains: solidify handles any polygon, loop cut needs quads only along the ring it cuts, and subdivision uses SubdivisionMeshNode's mixed Catmull-Clark.
testing-plan:
1. A timing harness over the three models (tmp/, not committed unless asked).
2. Fingerprints before and after.
3. mvn test.
changes-made: Step 1 measurements (MESH-60 agent, before any code change; worktree mesh-60 on eng-33). Harness: tracked benchmark HalfEdgeBuildBenchmark#representationsOnLargestModels (new test method, benchmark/ dir, run with -Dtest=), 2 warm-up + 7 timed rounds per model, ArrayMesh and HalfEdgeMesh alternating which goes first each round, medians; log tmp/mesh60-bench-1.log. Per sample: load = parser to ArrayMesh; build = ArrayMesh edge topology (QuadMeshTopologyHelper) vs toHalfEdgeMesh (packedBuild + normals); retained = heap delta after GC holding the mesh; compile = compileSurfaceData (the render buffer); edgeLines = the wireframe LineSet over every edge (rest of upload); texturedSplit = CornerUvSplit for the textured draw. FERTILITY V=13971 F=27954: Array load 22.2 build 2.9 ms 2.9 MiB compile 0.2 edges 1.0 | HalfEdge load 22.3 build 2.6 ms 6.9 MiB compile 0.4 edges 0.9. BUDDHA V=99370 F=198736: Array load 100.8 build 21.5 ms 35.1 MiB compile 1.4 edges 8.1 | HalfEdge load 100.9 build 21.9 ms 79.5 MiB compile 2.3 edges 5.6. CRAWFISH IMG_4109 raw GLB V=468350 F=936035: Array load 36.1 (warm, parse after the first) build 117.3 ms 108.0 MiB compile 7.4 edges 49.4 split 23.9 | HalfEdgeMesh REFUSED: 'Degenerate edge on vertex 53309' (the raw scan is non-manifold; the quad suite's crawfish load fails on the same exception). CRAWFISH repaired (repair_mesh median 617 ms; V=469131 F=938302 rebuilt from its arrays): Array build 90.8 ms 108.0 MiB compile 7.5 edges 31.1 | HalfEdge build 83.0 ms 261.3 MiB compile 12.2 edges 25.1. Verdict: construction time equal within noise on all three, compile +1-5 ms, edge lines faster on HalfEdge; memory 2.2-2.4x (crawfish +153 MiB). First frame (run-scene sceneReady wait, mesh-viewer, 3 rotated rounds, tmp/mesh60-firstframe-base.txt): crawfish 2.0 s, buddha 1.0-2.0 s, fertility 1.0 s (route resolution is 1 s). A dense path must stay for meshes with no half-edge form: raw scans (non-manifold/degenerate) and repair_mesh output with unoriented edges (MeshRepair already returns an ArrayMesh there).

Step 1 baselines (before any code change): quad suite 14/14 MATCH against mesh-59-step2 (signatures and screenshots; /home/acw/Code/Ixdar/tmp/quad-suite/mesh-60-before). DSL fixtures sweep (tmp/mesh60-fixtures-base.txt, 40 DSLs, 0 timeouts) byte-identical to MESH-59 step 2. Ring fingerprints/regions on crawfish and fertility, dungeon_2d/3d fingerprints and the timing/node-inspect JSON shapes (tmp/mesh60-regress-base.txt) identical to MESH-59 step 2 apart from log paths and ports. Scripts: tmp/mesh60-fixtures.sh, tmp/mesh60-regress.sh, tmp/mesh60-dungeon-fingerprint.sh, tmp/mesh60-firstframe.sh. Stopped at the phase gate; step 2 waits for the user.

Step 2 implemented (uncommitted, worktree mesh-60), per user decision (a). ArrayMesh keeps its name and is only the indexed form of meshes HalfEdgeMesh cannot hold; only MeshLoader.indexedMesh (all four parsers: HalfEdgeMesh bulk build in file order with the file's normals, else ArrayMesh) and MeshRepair (unoriented output, and its weld stage) build one; QuadMeshTopologyHelper is folded into ArrayMesh's private Topology. Deleted: ArrayMeshEngine, QuadMeshTopologyHelper, ArrayMesh.toHalfEdgeMesh/withPositions/fromQuads/copy*/compileSurfaceData and its op statics, HalfEdgeMeshEngine.fromMeshTopology and compileSurfaceData, HalfEdgeMesh.compileSurfaceData, SemanticPatchDecomposer.toArrayMesh, GeometryBundle.mutableMesh, MeshMergeByDistance.mergeToArrayMesh, the viewer's on-demand half-edge copy, AutomationRuntime.normalizeMeshPositions and BatchDslEvaluator.normalizeArrayMesh (replaced by MeshDistance.normalizedPositions). No instanceof ArrayMesh/HalfEdgeMesh or casts remain in main: MeshTopology.asHalfEdgeMesh(consumer) (HalfEdgeMesh returns itself; ArrayMesh throws '<node> needs a manifold mesh ... run repair_mesh on it first'), plus default packedPositions()/packedFaceVertices(); HalfEdgeMeshEngine gains compact, denseTriangles and a bulk subdivideQuadsOnce(MeshTopology). Every producer and node builds HalfEdgeMesh in the old vertex/face order: CubeMesh, CoonsPatch, CheckerMaterial, Extrude (face normals computed the old unit way so positions are unchanged), Inset, LoopCut (loopCutAxis inlined), Solidify (SolidifyMeshNode.solidifyQuads, also used by BiRailLoft), Subdivide, Subdivision (edges from a bulk build, numbered in first-appearance order exactly as the old helper), Transform, GridMapQuads/QuadExtract (ExtractedQuadMesh.toMesh), GridToMesh2D/3D, DebugCapsuleRuntime, MeshAppend.join, MeshDelete*, MeshVertexOffset, MeshMergeByDistance (weldArrays keeps the indexed weld for repair). DoD 7: HalfEdgeCompiledMeshData moved to ixdar.graphics.render.model; HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.compileSurface(MeshTopology) is the one compile path and the textured draw splits UVs straight from that buffer (CornerUvSplit now works on arrays); the geometry engine has no rendering code. Analysis classes take MeshTopology or packed arrays. Behaviour change: segment_cap, dual_radial_segment, bridge_edge_loops, adaptive_bridge_loops, surface_metric (and the other half-edge nodes) refuse a raw non-manifold mesh with that named message instead of passing it through.

Step 2 verification. DSL fixtures sweep (40 DSLs) byte-identical to the step-1 baseline; ring fingerprints/regions (crawfish, fertility), dungeon_2d/3d fingerprints and timing/node-inspect shapes identical (tmp/mesh60-*-diff.txt); quad suite 14/14 MATCH vs mesh-60-before, signatures and screenshots (/home/acw/Code/Ixdar/tmp/quad-suite/mesh-60-after). Unit suite 538/538. Screenshots tmp/mesh-60-crawfish.png and tmp/mesh-60-subdivided-cube.png (test_function: cube subdivided twice) are bit-identical to a pristine eng-33 build (image-diff rmse 0), so no screenshot changed: loaded models keep the file's normals and the quad meshes the touched producers emit have equal-area faces, where area-weighted and unit-sum vertex normals agree. A/B re-run (HalfEdgeBuildBenchmark#representationsOnLargestModels, tmp/mesh60-bench-2.log, 7 rounds, medians, machine busier than step 1 so absolute times are higher for both): fertility build Array 3.5 / HalfEdge 2.8 ms, retained 2.2 / 6.4 MiB, compile 1.5 / 2.1 ms; buddha build 24.3 / 25.6 ms, 27.1 / 71.5 MiB, compile 5.5 / 5.0 ms; crawfish raw Array build 100.3 ms 84 MiB compile 13.2 ms (HalfEdge refused, named message); crawfish repaired build 87.3 / 74.7 ms, 84 / 237 MiB, compile 14.5 / 18.4 ms, edge lines 37.9 / 22.6 ms; repair_mesh 641 ms. First frame, interleaved base (pristine eng-33 copy) vs change, 5 rounds (tmp/mesh60-firstframe-ab.txt): crawfish, fertility and buddha all 2.0-2.1 s on both, within the 1 s resolution of the sceneReady probe, so load and first-frame are within budget. Launch entries: 'MESH-60: mesh-viewer crawfish' and 'MESH-60: mesh-viewer test_function (subdivided cube)'; a third, 'MESH-60: mesh-viewer subdivided cube', points at the group-only groups/subdivided_cube.dsl and renders nothing (wt has no remove verb; land strips it).

wt done passed (build, launch 'MESH-60: mesh-viewer crawfish', screenshot tmp/mesh-60-launch.png, marked REVIEW). eng-33 was re-committed during the work (38b096d5; NodeGraphRuntime/Scene/automation edits); wt done replayed the change onto it after one import conflict in AutomationRuntime (both sides' imports were dead). After the replay the DSL fixtures sweep and the ring/dungeon regression were re-run and are still byte-identical to the step-1 baseline.

Manifold-input ports (follow-up, user-approved): MeshTopology.asHalfEdgeMesh is deleted from MeshTopology, HalfEdgeMesh and ArrayMesh. A node declares a geometry input that needs a half-edge mesh with InputPort.manifoldGeometry(name) (new public final boolean InputPort.needsManifoldMesh, set through a private validating constructor the public ones delegate to). NodeGraphRuntime.evaluate checks every such port once, just before the node's evaluate, and throws InvalidMeshTopologyException('<registered node id>' + NodeGraphRuntime.NEEDS_MANIFOLD_MESH), the same text as before. The 14 nodes (surface_metric, bridge_edge_loops, adaptive_bridge_loops, arc_network, segment_cap, dual_radial_segment, quad_extract, ring_at_branch, spline_ring, ring_candidates, spline_cut, loop_through_points, plus cross_field (NDirectionField) and motorcycle_graph (MotorcycleGraph), which are registered nodes, not boundary callers) declare the port and cast or simply read MeshTopology; none passes its own name. Boundary checks: ModelScene.loadModel (instanceof HalfEdgeMesh, else InvalidMeshTopologyException '<Scene> needs a manifold mesh...', text unchanged) and ListRings (ok=false, error 'rings list of <path> needs a manifold mesh...'). New ManifoldInputPortTest (ArrayMesh on surface_metric refused naming the node; HalfEdgeMesh passes); CrossFieldAssembly/Connection tests and the HalfEdgeBuild, RingAnchorOrder and RingCandidatesScan benchmarks no longer call it. MeshTopology also gains vertexIdBound/edgeIdBound/faceIdBound/halfEdgeIdBound for DoD 9. Verified: compile clean, unit suite 540/540, DSL fixtures sweep (40) identical to the step-1 baseline, ring fingerprints/regions and dungeon_2d/3d fingerprints identical (tmp/m60fix-compare.sh port), quad suite 14/14 MATCH vs mesh-60-before (/home/acw/Code/Ixdar/tmp/quad-suite/mesh-60-port). Refusal shown through ixdar-cli: mesh-viewer loading tmp/m60fix-refusal.dsl (load_mesh of the raw crawfish GLB into surface_metric) logs 'DSL load failed ...: surface_metric needs a manifold mesh, but this one has no half-edge form (non-manifold, degenerate or unoriented edges); run repair_mesh on it first' (tmp/logs/mesh-viewer-m60fix-refusal-1.log).

DoD 9 (callers use HalfEdgeMesh directly), lead plus five helper agents, uncommitted in worktree mesh-60. Deleted: MeshTopology.packedPositions/packedFaceVertices (and ArrayMesh's overrides), HalfEdgeMeshEngine.compact, denseTriangles and subdivideQuadsOnce, SemanticPatchDecomposer.fanTriangles/fanTriangleFaces; no main or test code calls them. New shared API: MeshTopology.vertexIdBound/edgeIdBound/faceIdBound/halfEdgeIdBound (HalfEdgeMesh: next*Id; ArrayMesh: counts), MeshTopology.triangleCount() and triangulate(TriangulationRule, int[] faceOfTriangle) with the new enum TriangulationRule {FAN (from the face's first corner), SHORTER_DIAGONAL (QuadTriangulation's rule: quads cut on the shorter diagonal, 0-2 on a tie)}; every MESH-60-ported path uses it with FAN (segmentation, MSC, discrete gradient, boundary snap, edge dihedrals, PrincipalDirectionField vertex normals, SurfaceCreases signed volume, RingCandidateExtractor region areas, skeleton voxelization). The other inline fan loops (fingerprint, render, export, PLY, picking, nearest vertex) and QuadTriangulation are MESH-63. ArrayMesh.positions/faceIndices/vertsPerFace are public final (dense buffers of the indexed form; used by test ManifoldShell and the crawfish benchmarks).
EdgeDihedrals is one contract: built by SemanticPatchDecomposer.computeEdgeDihedrals on the FAN triangles in active-face order; edges keyed by EdgeKey.undirected of vertex ids (inserted in that triangle order), faceNormals per fan triangle, positions by vertex id (3 * vertexIdBound), triangles (vertex ids) and triangleFaces (face id per triangle). PrincipalDirectionField, CrestLineDetector and SaddlePointDetector read ed.positions()/ed.triangles() (no second position copy); their arrays are vertex-id indexed (PrincipalDirectionField.vertexCount() is now vertexIdBound(); shared oneRings), and percentiles/medians are taken over live vertices only. CrestLines polylines, saddle seeds, segmentation labels, Patch.vertexIndices/faceIndices and the decompose route's face_indices/vertex_indices are input-mesh ids (identical for loaded triangle files, which are dense). Skeleton output is id-free.
Split n-gons (ruling): when a face's fan triangles land in different patches, SemanticPatchDecomposer.patchFaceIds gives the face to the patch holding most of its triangles, the lowest patch id on a tie, so each face is in exactly one patch (MscCellAssembly uses the same rule with its labels).
Per group: modifiers (helper A) - Solidify (solidifyQuads renamed solidify, BiRailLoft updated) accepts any polygon, side walls on boundary edges, bottom faces keep their first corner; LoopCut keeps the global axis-aligned edge rule and requires quads only on faces touching a cut edge (n-gons elsewhere pass through), otherwise refuses naming the face; SubdivideMeshNode stays LINEAR (one in-place subdivideOnce per level over any polygon, n-gon -> n quads), not Catmull-Clark - DoD 9's 'mixed Catmull-Clark' wording was wrong for this node; SubdivisionMeshNode runs one in-place mixed Catmull-Clark level per step with crease weights read by input edge id; Extrude accepts mixed meshes (extrudedFromVertex now input ids); Inset uses real vertex ids; TransformGeometryNode has one path, and the lead re-keys the bezier handle slots from input edge ids onto the rebuilt mesh's edges (the output edge joining the same vertices, start/end swapped when it runs the other way), so handles stay attached when input edge ids are sparse. Mesh ops (B) - MeshAppend, MeshVertexOffset, MeshDeleteVertices, MeshMergeByDistance.weldArrays read in place; weld maps keep their documented dense contract. Curvature/distance (C) - PDF/Crest/Saddle in id space, SurfaceCreases and LimbAxis read in place (LimbAxis's mixed-polygon branch still splits through QuadTriangulation's shorter diagonal, per ruling; QuadTriangulation is MESH-63), MeshDistance's dead public methods removed. Segmentation/skeleton (D) - all eight files id-space; MeshSkeletonExtractor reads sparse meshes in place. Rings/tools (E) - RingCandidateExtractor and BranchCrossSectionRing run the skeleton on the surface directly (regionByVertex now id-indexed; dead public fields dense and TRIANGLE_CORNERS removed), SkeletonSensitivityAnalyzer no longer compacts, mesh Compare uses MeshDistance.extractPositions, PatchDecomposerCLI stats/crest output id-indexed. User-accepted bug fixes (E): RingCandidateExtractor region areas now fan-triangulate n-gons (the old step-of-3 read of packed corners was misaligned on n-gons) and PatchDecomposerCLI's angle defect uses each n-gon corner's real interior angle; both identical on triangle meshes. Left as found and noted: BoundarySnap's pre-existing System.out logging, MorseSmaleDecomposer's dead private refinement methods, SubdivideMeshNode's pre-existing System.err level-cap line. docs/mesh-node-catalog.json (solidify description, cube description) and ARCHITECTURE.md (representation and modifier package text) regenerated by the build.
Tests: loaded-mesh tests and benchmarks cast the loader's HalfEdgeMesh and recompute normals instead of repacking; parser tests read corners/positions in place; RingCandidatesTest deforms the icosphere in place; RingDeletionTest drops compact; ManifoldShell takes the ArrayMesh weld output.
Verification (after all of the above, the five methods deleted): compile clean (catalog and ARCHITECTURE.md regenerated); unit suite 540/540 (tmp/mesh-60-measurements.json updated); DSL fixtures sweep (40 DSLs, tmp/mesh60-fixtures-dod9.txt) byte-identical to the step-1 baseline; ring fingerprints and regions on crawfish and fertility, dungeon_2d/3d fingerprints and the timing/node-inspect shapes identical (bash tmp/m60fix-compare.sh dod9); quad suite 14/14 MATCH vs mesh-60-before, signatures and screenshots (/home/acw/Code/Ixdar/tmp/quad-suite/mesh-60-dod9.out). No recorded output changed: every behaviour change above applies only to inputs the old code refused (n-gons on solidify, non-quad faces away from loop-cut edges, mixed meshes on extrude/subdivide) or to n-gon cases the old code read misaligned (E's two accepted fixes, split n-gon patch ownership), none of which the fixtures, rings, dungeons or quad suite exercise.

wt done (DoD 9 round): the replay onto master c5f02fd1 (ENG-32, ENG-33, ENG-34 landed meanwhile) stopped on two conflicts. ListRings: kept ENG-34's failure() helper for the not-found error and the manifold refusal, and dropped this change's OK/ERROR constants. .vscode/launch.json: kept master's entries plus this ticket's two MESH-60 entries, dropping the MESH-59/ENG-32/ENG-33 entries that this branch carried from its old base and that their land had stripped. Then wt continue and wt done passed: build, launch 'MESH-60: mesh-viewer crawfish' (screenshot tmp/mesh-60-launch.png), marked REVIEW. Re-verified after the replay: unit suite 540/540, DSL fixtures sweep and ring/dungeon/timing regression identical to the step-1 baseline (tmp/m60fix-compare-replayed.txt). Side effect of the replay: the rename of HalfEdgeCompiledMeshData into graphics/render/model now shows as a deletion plus an untracked file, no longer staged as a rename; nothing else in the index was touched by hand.
review-summary: Every loader, node and analysis now works on HalfEdgeMesh in place; ArrayMesh remains only for broken scans, which nodes needing a manifold mesh refuse at their input port. One mesh type and one editing API replace the duplicated array code, converters and quad-only copies.
